label: Arduino Opta — Parc I/O via Modbus (Dragino RS485 gateway)
model: Opta RS485 slave → Dragino RS485-NB → PeakLogic Cloud
notes: Poll Opta as Modbus RTU slave (ID 2, 9600 8N1) from Dragino RS485-NB every 5 min (AT+TDC=300). Tag names match MQTT Parc (arduino_opta_parc): I1–I8, R1–R4, I1_RAW–I8_RAW, mA_AI3–6, scaled_AI3–6, MCSA_CH1_AMPS–CH6, PDM_P1/P2_HEALTH, H1–H8. Flash firmware/arduino-opta-rtu-slave/PeaklogicOptaRtuSlave on Opta RS485. Cloud: POST /api/parc/dragino-gateway/bind-preset with presetId opta_parc_modbus_dragino, then /plan for AT+COMMAND* blocks.
